name: @zelavis/ecommerce
description: Official Zelavis ecommerce service with runtime APIs, commerce domain APIs, and child provider services.
author: Ivan Jeremic

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @zelavis/server build && pnpm --filter @zelavis/db build && pnpm --filter @zelavis/auth build && pnpm --filter zelavis build:runtime && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @zelavis/server build && pnpm --filter @zelavis/db build && pnpm --filter @zelavis/auth build && pnpm --filter zelavis build:runtime && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
